dct_title_s: Damage Assessment in Chardonnieres commune, South department as of 23 August 2021
dct_description_sm: **UNOSAT code: EQ20210814HTI** This map illustrates potentially damaged structures/buildings in Chardonnieres commune, South department of Haiti as detected by Pleiades image acquired on 23 August 2021. Within the analyzed area, UNOSAT has identified 27 damaged structures, 107 potentially damaged structures, 9 landslide locations. This is a preliminary analysis and has not yet been validated in the field. Please send ground feedback to the United Nations Satellite Centre (UNOSAT).
